description:
Local-first AI token usage & cost tracker for 29 AI coding tools — with native apps. Never reads prompts.

TokenTracker is an accurate, local-first token usage and cost dashboard for 29 AI coding tools including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, and Qoder. It automatically collects token usage and aggregates everything locally, with a desktop pet, 4 native widgets, and 15 achievement tracks. No cloud account, no API keys, no setup. The Windows app runs as a system-tray companion that never reads your prompts.
What's Changed
- fix(windows): fall back to official releases when update checks are rate limited by @shixiaogaoya in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/784
- fix(zcode): avoid empty installs hiding sessions and usage by @shixiaogaoya in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/783
- fix(claude): skip OmO-mirrored sdk-ts transcript usage by @xiufengsun in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/788
- fix(omp): skip oversized transcript records instead of crashing sync by @RiriAgent in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/790
- chore(release): v1.3.14 by @xiufengsun in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/792
